question: Does the Avalar EISR support fish occurrence claims at named Cavite fishing grounds, or only broad Manila Bay fishery context?
reviewScope: Manila Bay (Cavite-side proposed-project context); no named bay, municipality, river, exact station or project parcel receives a fish-species assignment.

sourceReview.title: Environmental Impact Statement Report: Proposed Seabed Dredging & Quarrying Project, Manila Bay under the Municipal Waters of Cavite City, Noveleta and Rosario, Cavite
sourceReview.publisher: Environmental Management Bureau, DENR; proponent: Avalar Mining Corporation

reviewedIndexContent: Table of contents and indexed excerpts for Tables 2.2.6, 2.2.9 and 2.2.10
Indexed narrative about actual fishing operations and key-informant interviews

projectAndSurveyContext.projectStatusScope: The EIS describes a proposed 2021 seabed project; its present status was not checked.
projectAndSurveyContext.sourceDescribedLocation: Manila Bay municipal waters of Cavite City, Noveleta and Rosario; the broader fish-list caption also names Kawit and coastal waters around San Nicolas Shoal.
projectAndSurveyContext.marineEcologyStudyWindow: 20-27 May 2021, according to the EIS executive-summary schedule.
projectAndSurveyContext.distinction: The study window and actual fishing documentation dates are historical EIS dates, not a current fish survey or current fishery status.

evidenceReview.disposition: Retain as a historical, broad Manila Bay fishery-context source. It supports neither individual-waterbody species rows nor current presence, abundance, completeness, catchability, diet, safety or legal advice.
evidenceReview.possibleOverlap: This is a different 2021 project EIS from the already reviewed Island C reclamation EIS, but both cover nearby Cavite-side Manila Bay fishing grounds. Their source data and independence have not been compared; do not count them as independent confirmations.
evidenceReview.table2_2_6: The indexed table caption says coordinates were recorded for actual fishing operations on 20 and 22 May 2021. No station coordinates or map geometry are copied here, and the available excerpts do not crosswalk fish taxa to those operations.
evidenceReview.table2_2_9: The indexed table combines key-informant reports with actual fishing documentation. The two described direct catch-and-effort entries are swimming-crab catches; fish names in the same table are not thereby proven as direct catch from those two operations. Interview entries describe broader fishing grounds and seasonal context.
evidenceReview.table2_2_10: An indexed table lists fish names for fishing grounds described across Rosario, Noveleta, Cavite City and Kawit, and around San Nicolas Shoal. Its caption and indexed text do not give a per-taxon municipality, station, capture date or voucher crosswalk. No names or rows are transcribed into this review.

rights.decision: Retain minimal bibliographic metadata and a factual research synopsis only. No table text, taxon-name list, coordinates, image, map or geometry is reproduced; publication approval is false.

decision.assignmentScope: Shared Manila Bay research context only; no evidence is allocated to an individual municipality, bay, estuary, river, station or project parcel.

limits: Direct requests for the official PDF returned HTTP 403; the complete report and page layout were not independently inspected in this review.
The project footprint is not an aquatic habitat boundary or fish-survey geometry.
Interview or landed-catch reports are kept distinct from documented fishing operations and from standardized ecological sampling.
The source is from 2021 and does not establish present-day fish presence, abundance or fishing conditions.
No item-specific rights to reuse the EIS tables were verified.
The broad fish list may overlap other nearby EIS context and is not an independent species confirmation.
nextAction: If the original report becomes accessible through an authorized route, compare its station-to-catch records with the nearby Island C EIS and NFRDI survey before any taxon-level or waterbody-specific claim; separately verify taxonomy and reuse terms. No request was submitted.

sources.supports: Official EMB-hosted EISR and indexed contents/excerpts for marine-ecology methods, fishing documentation, and fisheries tables.
Official EMB project notice/listing identifying Avalar Mining Corporation and the Manila Bay project location.
